purpose: Reusable capture and content-format library for content planning.

groups.label: Teach / explain
groups.use_for: Make a useful mechanism, decision, or workflow understandable.

groups.label: Prove / demonstrate
groups.use_for: Show evidence, a client result, a tool, or a real workflow in motion.

groups.label: Converse / learn
groups.use_for: Learn in public through a guest, client, Q&A, or thoughtful exchange.

groups.label: Humanize / relate
groups.use_for: Give the audience context, lived experience, and a credible point of view.

formats.label: Physical guest podcast
formats.capture: Two or more people in the same physical space.
formats.best_for: Conversation, disagreement, stories, and buyer questions.

formats.label: Solo / direct-to-camera
formats.capture: One person speaking directly to the viewer.
formats.best_for: A clear promise, explanation, opinion, or CTA.

formats.label: Screen / slides / Miro
formats.capture: Screen recording, slides, diagram, or collaborative canvas.
formats.best_for: Mechanisms, walkthroughs, systems, and visual proof.

formats.label: Physical whiteboard
formats.capture: A person maps an idea on a physical board.
formats.best_for: Models, tradeoffs, process maps, and teaching by drawing.

formats.label: iPad / tablet
formats.capture: Handwritten or visual explanation on a tablet.
formats.best_for: Sketches, annotated examples, and intimate explanations.

formats.label: Outdoor + another mode
formats.capture: Outdoor context combined with direct-to-camera, screen, or conversation.
formats.best_for: Perspective, contrast, movement, and a human point of view.

formats.label: Online guest podcast
formats.capture: Remote guest conversation with a clear recording layout.
formats.best_for: Expertise, Q&A, case learning, and distributed teams.

formats.label: Client / case interview
formats.capture: A client or customer describes the problem, mechanism, and result.
formats.best_for: Proof, credibility, objections, and buyer relevance.

formats.label: Vlog
formats.capture: A day, project, or decision shown through lived moments.
formats.best_for: Context and relationship; keep it a minority of the mix, usually about 5–20%.

cadence_guidance.weekly_target: 3 core videos per week over 26 weeks yields 78 core videos; add 22 useful shorts for a 100-asset planning target.
cadence_guidance.cta: Place a contextual CTA after the viewer has received the useful proof; point to the next useful video when possible.
cadence_guidance.harvest: Treat a core video as a harvest source for selected shorts and posts; do not force every derivative onto every platform.

research_notes: Content libraries should connect attention to nurture and conversion.
Buyer relevance and useful proof matter more than mass reach.
Nate Herk's contribution is treated as process mapping and feedback loops, not as a brand identity.
Diffusion is the one normal supervised video Studio route.
Upstream HeyGen HyperFrames is used only for an entire code-animated video or one bounded overlay asset; it is not another editor.
